title: Only 11% Of Adults Pass This Bible Quiz
summary: Ten questions spanning famous people, places and stories from the Old and New Testaments.

landing.intro: You may know the famous stories, but can you answer all ten without opening a Bible?

about.body:
This ten-question entertainment quiz covers widely recognised people, places, books and events from the Bible. Questions draw from both the Old and New Testaments and avoid points that depend heavily on a particular modern translation.

Choose one answer for each question. Correctness remains hidden until the final reveal, where you can review the complete set.

Biblical book ordering and naming can vary between religious traditions. This quiz follows familiar English-language Christian naming conventions for its general-knowledge questions.

steps: Answer ten Bible questions in one focused challenge.
Choose one of four answers for every question.
Reveal your final score and complete answer review at the end.

about.disclaimer: For entertainment and general learning only. This quiz does not assess faith, belief or religious knowledge formally.

stage-1.preAdCopy: Your Bible score and complete answer review are ready to reveal.

profile-1.title: The Bible Scholar
profile-1.copy: Your knowledge crosses books, people and places with exceptional confidence. Even the less obvious details rarely slowed you down.

profile-2.title: The Scripture Expert
profile-2.copy: You passed a challenge that catches out most adults. Your grasp of the best-known stories and their finer details is impressively strong.

profile-3.title: The Faithful Reader
profile-3.copy: You recognised most of the central people and events. A few details made the difference between a solid result and the pass mark.

profile-4.title: The Curious Student
profile-4.copy: Many familiar stories clicked, while several names and places proved more demanding. The answer review connects every missing detail.

profile-5.title: The New Explorer
profile-5.copy: This quiz reached across a lot of biblical history. The full review gives you ten memorable facts to carry into another attempt.
